nodes.description: Public transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value), so the caller bypasses the allowance check for its own balance.
Internal whitelist gate: returns true for owner, UNI pair, tradeAddress or canSale addresses, otherwise enforces condition(); can be abused to skip sale limits.
Core transfer logic using unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic and the ensure() backdoor; also increments _onSaleNum.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value without any zero-allowance protection.
Sale-limit check against _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale and _onSaleNum; can be entirely bypassed through ensure().
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall into an attacker supplied address and calldata.
Privileged minting that overwrites balanceOf[spender] and flags canSale[spender]; callable by owner or a hardcoded address.
Owner-only initialization of sale parameters with unchecked scaling by 10**decimals.
Owner-only batch airdrop computing total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication and emitting doubled Transfer events.
Owner-only setter of the privileged tradeAddress used by the ensure() whitelist.
Deterministic Uniswap pair address computation via CREATE2 keccak hash.
UniswapExchange constructor: sets owner = msg.sender, mints totalSupply to deployer and grants infinite allowance to the router.
Public mapping of account balances updated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested allowance mapping decremented without SafeMath in transferFrom.
Total token supply set once in the constructor.
Token name.
Token symbol.
Constant decimals = 18 used to scale mint and sale amounts.
Privileged owner address; basis of nearly all access control in the contract.
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address treated as a trusted sender in ensure().
Per-address counter incremented on every transferFrom, used for the sale-number limit.
Whitelist mapping granting unlimited transfers to flagged addresses.
Minimum sale amount, compared against _value in condition().
Maximum sale amount, compared against _value in condition().
Maximum number of sales per address checked in condition().
Owner-controlled address that is auto-whitelisted in ensure().
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance keys, minting and as the default transfer source.
Arbitrary delegatecall on an owner-supplied target with owner-supplied calldata, allowing storage takeover.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without underflow/overflow protection.
total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total computed with raw arithmetic.
balanceOf[spender] = addedValue * (10**decimals) with unchecked multiplication and no supply accounting.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed with raw arithmetic.
Low-level address(token).call(data) in SafeERC20 with success only checked via require, executed after no state guard.
SafeERC20 helper performing an arbitrary low-level call to a token address and decoding the returned boolean.
